app.title: Penrose Tiling
board.label: Board
hint.place: Hover the edge to preview · Wheel to rotate · Click to place · Drag to pan · Ctrl + wheel to zoom
hint.touch: Drag a tile from below onto the edge · Tap the pending tile to rotate · Drag it back to remove · Drag to pan · Pinch to zoom
tray.label: Tile tray
about.title: About Penrose Tiling
about.intro: A tile-laying game built on the kites and darts of the Penrose tiling. Every tile must obey the matching rules; the game ends as soon as the boundary has a gap that no tile can fill.
about.fonts.title: Fonts
about.fonts.credit: The interface fonts are based on LINE Seed Sans and LINE Seed TW by LY Corporation. This game keeps only the characters the interface uses and renames them PTG Sans and PTG Sans TC, distributed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1.
about.fonts.license: SIL Open Font License 1.1, full text
settings.title: Settings
settings.arcs.note: Arc colors adapt to the color scheme automatically. Turn the arcs off to see only the shapes, as a harder mode.
gameOver.title: Game over
gameOver.reason: The boundary has a gap that no tile can fill.
gameOver.doomedAt: Doomed by step {n} at the latest
analysis.title: Game analysis
analysis.completeRadiusHint: The largest circle around the centre that tiles cover completely.
analysis.roundnessHint: How much of a circle with the same area, around the same centre, the tiles cover.
analysis.backtraceValue: Doomed by step {n} at the latest
analysis.backtraceHint: Found by filling in forced tiles, so the real mistake may be even earlier. In the replay, that step's tile is outlined, and the dashed red rings mark where the game finally got stuck.
analysis.backtraceUnavailable: The backtrace could not be computed.
share.file: Too long for a link, so the record was saved as a file
share.viewing: A shared record. Your own game in progress and your personal best are not affected.
share.error.title: Cannot open this record
share.error.version: This record comes from a different version of the game (record format {version}; this version reads only format {expected}).
share.error.malformed: This link or file is not a valid game record.
